- Close dates: if fuzzy, set the conservative month and add comment with next step.
- Probability: re-evaluate for deals with new technical blockers.

- 13:05–13:15: Top 8 deals (owners give 60s signal)
- 13:15–13:25: Stage & documentation checks (revops + finance)
